create_optimizer_from_config: create a ClassyOptimizer instance from a configuration dictionary using the from_config class method
set_param_groups_with_scheduler: set optimizer param groups with a ParamScheduler to automatically schedule learning rate during training
step_optimizer_with_where: step the optimizer with a where value to update parameters based on training progress
access_optimizer_options_view: access the current learning rate and momentum values through the options_view property
checkpoint_optimizer_state: save and restore the optimizer state using get_classy_state and set_classy_state for checkpointing
